items.distractor_fact: එදින මගේ නිවසේ තාප මානයේ කියවීම {D}°C විය.
items.gloss_en: That day, the reading on my home thermometer was D°C.
items.entity_note: a personal instrument owned by a person (my home thermometer), a different kind of owner from the first distractor's neighboring park (a place).

items.distractor_fact: එදින වෙනත් කොටස් දර්ශකයක අගය ${D} විය.
items.gloss_en: That day, another stock index's value was $D.
items.entity_note: a market index (a series/instrument), a different kind of owner from the first distractor's another company (an organisation).

items.distractor_fact: එදින නාගරික ජල මාපකයේ කියවීම මීටර් {D}ක් විය.
items.gloss_en: That day, the reading on the municipal water meter was D meters.
items.entity_note: a municipal instrument (a water meter run by a city body), a different kind of owner from the first distractor's adjacent reservoir (a place).

items.distractor_fact: එදිනම විනිසුරුවෙකුගේ උස මාන යන්ත්‍රයේ කියවීම මීටර් {D}ක් විය.
items.gloss_en: That same day, a judge's altitude-measuring instrument reading was D meters.
items.entity_note: a person's measuring instrument (a judge's device), a different kind of owner from the first distractor's another balloon (an object/vehicle).

items.distractor_fact: වෙනත් බැංකුවක එදින වූ මධ්‍යම ගිණුම් ශේෂය ${D} විය.
items.gloss_en: At a different bank, that day's average account balance was $D.
items.entity_note: a different bank (an organisation), a different kind of owner from the first distractor's another account (an object/instrument).

items.distractor_fact: වෙනත් බැංකුවක එම සතියේම එකතු වූ තැන්පතු ප්‍රමාණය ${D} විය.
items.gloss_en: At a different bank, the total deposits collected that same week amounted to $D.
items.entity_note: a different bank (an organisation), a different kind of owner from the first distractor's another account (an object/instrument).

items.distractor_fact: සමාගමේ අධ්‍යක්ෂකගේ එම මාසයේ පුද්ගලික ආදායම ${D} විය.
items.gloss_en: The company director's personal income that month was $D.
items.entity_note: a specific person (the director), a different kind of owner from the first distractor's another department (an organisation).

items.distractor_fact: වෙනත් ලීගයක එම වාරයේ ශූර කණ්ඩායම ගෝල {D}ක් රැස් කළේය.
items.gloss_en: In a different league, that season, the champion team scored D goals.
items.entity_note: a different league's champion (a different series/competition, not just another team in the same league), a different kind of owner from the first distractor's another team.

items.distractor_fact: වෙනත් සමාගමක එම වර්ෂයේ ලද ලාභය ${D} විය.
items.gloss_en: A different company's profit that year was $D.
items.entity_note: a company (an organisation), a different kind of owner from the first distractor's another investment (an object).

items.distractor_fact: එම කර්මාන්තයේ ස්වාධීන කොන්ත්‍රාත්කරුවෙකුගේ එම මාසයේ නිෂ්පාදනය ටොන් {D}ක් විය.
items.gloss_en: An independent contractor in that industry's production that month was D tons.
items.entity_note: a person (an independent contractor) with no stated target of their own, a different kind of owner from the first distractor's another factory (an organisation).

items.distractor_fact: පුද්ගලික කාලගුණ සේවාවක් විසින් එම මාසයේ වාර්තා කළ වර්ෂාපතනය මිලිමීටර් {D}ක් විය.
items.gloss_en: A private weather service's reported rainfall for that month was D millimeters.
items.entity_note: an organisation (a private weather service) with its own unstated forecast, a different kind of owner from the first distractor's another city (a place).

items.distractor_fact: විකුණුම් නියෝජිතයෙකුගේ පුද්ගලික විකුණුම් ප්‍රමාණය එම කාර්තුවේ ${D} විය.
items.gloss_en: An individual sales agent's personal sales that quarter were $D.
items.entity_note: a person (a sales agent) with no stated target of their own, a different kind of owner from the first distractor's another branch (an organisation).

items.distractor_fact: වෙනත් ක්‍රීඩාංගණයක ක්‍රීඩකයෙක් එදිනම ගැසූ පහර ගණන {D}ක් විය.
items.gloss_en: On a different golf course, a player that same day took D strokes.
items.entity_note: a player on a different course, with that course's own unstated par (a person on ground of its own), a different kind of owner from the first distractor's another tournament (a series).

items.distractor_fact: එදිනම වෙනත් බස් සේවාවක පැමිණීමේ වේලාව, දිනයේ ආරම්භයේ සිට ගණන් කළ විට, මිනිත්තු {D}ක් විය.
items.gloss_en: That same day, a different bus service's arrival time, counted from the start of the day, was minute D.
items.entity_note: a bus service (a different organisation and mode of transport) with its own unstated timetable, a different kind of owner from the first distractor's another train on a different rail line.

items.distractor_fact: මගේ බාප්පාගේ නිවසේ, එහිම මහල් අංකනයට අනුව, ඔහුගේ මහල මහල් {D} වේ.
items.gloss_en: In my uncle's house, according to that house's own floor numbering, his floor is floor D.
items.entity_note: a specific person's residence (my uncle, a person), with its own floor-numbering reference, a different kind of owner from the first distractor's adjacent building (a place).

items.distractor_fact: එම වැඩසටහන පවත්වන ආයතනය විසින් වාර්තා කළ සාමාන්‍ය ආරම්භක බර කිලෝග්‍රෑම් {D}ක් විය.
items.gloss_en: The organisation running that program reported an average starting weight of D kilograms.
items.entity_note: an organisation (the program's operator), a different kind of owner from the first distractor's another participant (a person).

items.distractor_fact: එදින වෙනත් තරගයකදී ක්‍රීඩකයෙක් තනිව රැස් කළ ගෝල ගණන {D}ක් විය.
items.gloss_en: That day, in a different match, a player individually scored D goals.
items.entity_note: an individual player (a person), a different kind of owner from the first distractor's another team in another match (an organisation).

items.distractor_fact: එදිනම රිලේ කණ්ඩායමක් වාර්තා කළ මුළු වේලාව තත්පර {D}ක් විය.
items.gloss_en: That same day, a relay team's recorded total time was D seconds.
items.entity_note: a team (an organisation), a different kind of owner from the first distractor's another runner in another heat (a person).

items.distractor_fact: කර්මාන්ත සංගමය විසින් වාර්තා කළ, එම කාර්තුවේ කර්මාන්තයේ සාමාන්‍ය ආදායම ${D} විය.
items.gloss_en: The industry association's reported average industry revenue for that quarter was $D.
items.entity_note: an industry association's aggregate benchmark (a different kind of organisation, an aggregator), a different kind of owner from the first distractor's a third company.

items.distractor_fact: එදිනම වෙනත් ක්‍රීඩාවකදී කණ්ඩායමක් රැස් කළ ලකුණු ප්‍රමාණය {D}ක් විය.
items.gloss_en: That same day, in a different game, a team's total score was D points.
items.entity_note: a team (an organisation), a different kind of owner from the first distractor's another player (a person).
